profile.headline: Software Engineer, AI/ML Infra @ Meta
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with a passion for tackling challenging problems and improving lives.

My focus is in the field of AI/ML, where I aim to leverage my background in Mathematics and Software Engineering to make a positive impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer, AI/ML Infrastructure
positions.description:
• Designed and deployed ML ranking and recommendation systems for Horizon Worlds and Facebook Instant Games, powering personalized content discovery for millions of users across VR and mobile.
• Built user interest-profiling pipelines from scratch, aggregating real-time engagement signals (clicks, impressions, session activity) into per-user preference profiles consumed by ranking, recommendation, and exploration models.
• Developed 12+ LLM-based content-understanding pipelines (Llama) classifying content across a 9-dimension taxonomy, becoming the data foundation for personalization across Games, Apps, and Worlds surfaces.
• Engineered high-signal feature sets for ranking models — including embedding similarity, temporal engagement features, and category affinity scores — enabling more granular and adaptive personalization.
• Reduced H-Ranking feature-extraction latency ~15% (272ms -> 231ms) through pipeline profiling and targeted service-level optimization.
• Eliminated a saw-tooth traffic pattern flooding downstream inference via async rate-limit tuning and job scheduling - downstream P90 300ms -> 20ms and $100K+ / yr in infra savings.
• Built device- and OS-segmented performance features (frame rate, load time, crash rate) enabling contextual ranking that downranks content only on affected device segments rather than globally.
• Led end-to-end latency optimization of a text-to-animation diffusion pipeline (LLaMA-based motion transformer), achieving a 3.1x production speedup on the dominant inference stage via GPU profiling and TensorRT, with quality validated on golden prompts and automated + LLM-based evals.

positions.title: Mentor & Tester
positions.description:
• Provided academic support for students enrolled in DeepLearning.AI courses on topics related to machine learning, deep learning, and mathematical foundations for machine learning and data science.
• Thoroughly tested and reviewed new course content, and provided detailed feedback and recommendations for fixes to optimize the learning experience.
• Mentor for the following Coursera/DeepLearning.AI courses:
  - Machine Learning Specialization
  - Deep Learning Specialization
  - Mathematics for Machine Learning and Data Science Specialization
  - GANs Specialization

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a language selection feature from scratch and deployed it in production on the Connect Cases Home card, used by thousands of support agents.
• Owned and led massive code migrations in Google Ads.
• Worked on Machine Learning model migrations, writing SQL queries to materialize tables used for training models to improve agent assignment based on Case context and features.
• Received one-on-one monthly Machine Learning mentorship sessions from a Staff SWE on the ML team.
• Received 2 peer bonuses for improving Google codebase health and making substantial contributions to legacy code API removal.
• Completed and earned certificates for level 1 and level 2 A11y (Accessibility) training.
• Top 1000 code change submitter (company-wide) during a half-year period. Earned a badge for this.

positions.title: Content Contributor
positions.description:
• Wrote and tested code for developing course materials.
• Authored lessons, projects, and quizzes covering SQL and Python concepts.
• Produced questions and review cards for the Codecademy Go app on iOS and Android, downloaded by 1 million+ learners, covering concepts in computer science and programming languages (Java, Python, C++, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL).
• Created over 500 posts for the Codecademy forums making questions and answers regarding computer science and software development concepts covered in courses.

positions.title: Advisor/Coach
positions.description:
• Advised and supported the 10,000+ paying learners on Codecademy in multiple programming languages (Java, Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL) in live one-on-one online chat sessions.
• Taught coding concepts, reviewed and debugged code, and advised learners on learning paths and goals for software development.
• Moderated and led over 600 students in the Codecademy Intensive Web Development course, keeping learners engaged, and providing support and resources throughout the duration of the course.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Learned and utilized Java and PHP for work on the codebase of the online tool utilized by ITS consultants around campus.
• Reviewed hundreds of lines of legacy code - rewrote code comments and functions and fixed minor bugs.

positions.title: Information Technology Services Lab Consultant
positions.description:
• Assisted students, faculty, and staff with technology questions in computer labs around campus, answering any general questions about using software based on Mac OS, Windows, or Linux operating systems.
• Maintained proper operation of computer hardware and printers.
